title: Northern Employee Benefits Services Pension Plan Act
verified_how: Register index entry 'Northern Employee Benefits Services Pension Plan Act', consolidation date April 1, 2025. The consolidation's cover page prints 'NORTHERN EMPLOYEE BENEFITS SERVICES PENSION PLAN ACT / SNWT 2015,c.6 / In force October 1, 2015 / SI-005-2015' (French: 'LOI SUR LE REGIME DE PENSION DES NORTHERN EMPLOYEE BENEFITS SERVICES / LTNO 2015, ch. 6'), amended by SNWT 2018,c.13 (in force January 8, 2019; SI-015-2018), SNWT 2021,c.16 (in force September 30, 2023; SI-003-2023) and SNWT 2024,c.9[F]. Cover page carries the standard notice: 'This consolidation is not an official statement of the law. It is an office consolidation prepared by Legislation Division, Department of Justice, for convenience only.' Not marked repealed. Administering department, per the register's 'Administering Departments' table dated October 13, 2025: Finance.
notes: This is the territory's own pension statute: it governs the multi-employer pension plan covering employees of NWT (and Nunavut) municipalities, housing associations, health authorities and similar northern public bodies. Canada's contributory public pensions are federal and out of scope: Canada Pension Plan, R.S.C. 1985, c. C-8 and Old Age Security Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. O-9. GNWT public servants are in the federal public service plan. The register also carries a Legislative Assembly Retiring Allowances Act and a Supplementary Retiring Allowances Act, but those cover only MLAs.
